prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the signalized intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver side by Driver 2, who had entered the intersection from a cross street. The impact was a broadside collision, and both vehicles came to rest near the northwest corner. Driver 1 reported pain in the left shoulder and was transported for evaluation. The injury pattern is consistent with the force and direction of the side impact observed at the scene. Damage to the struck vehicle is concentrated along the driver door, quarter panel and intrusion into the door frame, which matches the described impact. Driver 2 acknowledged the sequence of events at the scene, and two independent witnesses gave statements that agree with that account. Photographs taken at the scene show debris and damage consistent with the collision. Responding officers confirmed that a Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time, and no prior damage to the vehicle was noted during inspection. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
